entries.cf2c4cc4edebbf51: Its management philosophy sets out 'Close Community Ties and Sound Management'. The 18th Medium-Term Management Plan, covering the period from April 2025 to March 2028, sets out a policy of steadily moving toward becoming a 'Comprehensive Service Enterprise Group' through regional contribution that goes beyond the boundaries of group companies, with finance at its core, and aims to become 'a banking group that connects this town with you... connects regions and people, and creates a rich future for the region'. Toward its 150th anniversary of founding in February 2032, it is working to realize a business model that can grow together with the region.
